  "policy_reason": "“A person on our warranty team will review your case” meets the handoff requirement (P06, P14), and “your last name and either your licence plate or your repair-order number” requests only permitted verification details (P02, P03).",

  "invented_reason": "“Will review your case, including the diagnostic fee” describes the next step without asserting a fee amount, coverage, or vehicle record.",
  "wrong_commitment": false,
  "commitment_reason": "“I can't waive the fee or confirm any coverage” makes clear that the handoff is for review, not approval.",
  "tone_ok": false,
  "tone_reason": "The reply opens with “I'm sorry” rather than what it can do and stacks limits in “I can't waive the fee or confirm any coverage, and I don't need your VIN.”"
